8176.title: Repeated quote-offset scans stall composer edits
8176.rootCauseOneLine: Each quote endpoint rescans earlier lines and recomputes prefix lengths, producing quadratic work for linearly many text and mention nodes.

prReviews.verdict: Targets root cause — static inspection only
prReviews.topFinding: The diff replaces repeated prefix scans and reductions with cached prefix deltas and binary search. No PR code or tests were executed; its absolute timing guard is load-sensitive.

8176.proposedFix: Precompute line ends and cumulative prefix deltas once, then binary-search endpoints while preserving blank-line and nested-quote mappings.
8176.caveats: Both clean runs used a locally authored jsdom fixture on unchanged trusted main. Test source and output are embedded inline per report-repository policy. Exact originally reported timings were not retested. No duplicate fix PR was opened because open PR #8177 already closes this issue.
